releaseNotes: Release v22 - Version 4.2: Cellular Voice MMS Pipeline & Ingestion/Transmission Hardening. Adaptive AMR-WB voice compression, hardware SMS_SENT and SMS_DELIVERED PendingIntent callbacks, resilient in-flight Room outbox state machine, and 3-stage adaptive MMSC download polling.

Release v21 - Version 4.0: The Living Software Ecosystem & Admin Governance. MutationLog black box auditing, BPE outbox micro-compression, CellularMedic crash interceptor & rollback engine, CellularIntentRouter, and interactive Admin Approval UI for SDUI mutations.
Release v19 - Differential Mini-App Patching (OTA Deltas) with RFC 6902 JsonPatchEngine and Transport Fallback Orchestrator.
Release v18 - Messaging Reliability Sprint: strict AI SMS number filtering in PallySmsReceiver & PallySmsObserver, robust outbound multipart SMS dispatching, and APK installation fallback.
